endorsements.name: Saqib A. Khan, M.S.
endorsements.label: Stealth Data Dispersal: ICMP Moon-Bounce
endorsements.description: This research is targeted at demonstrating that small amounts of data can be dispersed over IP based networks, utilizing the data payloads of existing protocols. Such data is expected to be kept alive on the ether until one chooses to retrieve it. The crux of the scheme is the fact that this type of data dispersal is expected to be extremely difficult to detect. Such a scheme also raises some very interesting aspects regarding using Internet traffic itself as virtual mass storage system, etc.
